data.gender_notes: Liza is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Elizabeth, which means 'God is my oath' or 'God is my promise'. In the New Testament, Elizabeth was the mother of John the Baptist. The name Liza carries the meaning “God's Promise” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Liza usually hope their child will grow to embody god's promise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Liza total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
